**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 already contains a full vendor insurance clause that hits the preferred position on every material term:

- **CGL** — USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate ✓
- **E&O** — USD 2M ✓
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5M ✓ (the correct tier given Cobalt hosts our health data)
- **Workers' comp** — as required by law ✓ (plus employer's liability USD 1M, an extra)
- **Duration** — term plus one year ✓
- **Certificates** — available on request under 18.2 ✓

Section 18.2 also adds three points that run in our favour: policies primary to Juniper Ridge's own insurance, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (so the coverage floors can't be argued as a de facto liability cap).
